description: White-water rafting through the Swiss Grand Canyon: the Ruinaulta gorge with its dramatic white limestone walls and turquoise Rhine.

name: Chur - Mittenberg Vineyard Walk
description: Walk through the Chur Mittenberg vineyards on the hillside above the city: working wine terraces with views over the Rhine valley.

name: Chur - Lenzerheide Lake Hike
description: Drive or bus to Lenzerheide for a hike around the beautiful Heidsee lake: easy trail through larch forest with mountain panoramas.

name: Chur - Arosa Weisshorn Summer Hike
description: Train to Arosa then cable car to the Weisshorn summit at 2653m: a vast 360-degree panorama over the Graubünden Alps.

name: Chur - Plessur Gorge Trail
description: Hike through the Plessur gorge carved by the river that flows through Chur: forested canyon walls and a dramatic rocky landscape.

name: Chur - Flims Caumasee Lake Swim
description: Bus or car to Flims for a swim in the turquoise Caumasee forest lake: one of the most beautiful natural swimming spots in Switzerland.

name: Chur - Ems-Felsberg Rhine Riverside Cycle
description: Flat cycle route north of Chur along the Rhine through the industrial village of Ems and the castle village of Felsberg.

name: Chur - Brambrüesch Alpine Flower Trail
description: Gondola to Brambrüesch then walk the flower trail through high alpine meadows above Chur: orchids gentians and sweeping valley views.

name: Chur - Malteser Keller Wine Evening
description: Chur's finest wine cellar bar in a historic vaulted basement: focus on Graubünden Pinot Noir and rare regional white varieties.

name: Chur - Flims Farm-to-Table Dinner
description: Dinner at one of Flims's excellent mountain restaurants using local Graubünden produce: venison game mushrooms and alpine cheese.

name: Chur - Graubünden Cuisine Evening Stern
description: Traditional Bündner dinner at Hotel Stern: Capuns Maluns Bündnerfleisch and Nusstorte in a centuries-old Chur institution.

name: Chur - Chur Saturday Market Arcas
description: Saturday market in the Arcas square with regional farmers selling Graubünden cheese Bündnerfleisch bread honey and produce.

name: Chur - Bündner Nusstorte Baking Class
description: Learn to bake the iconic Engadin nut tart in a Chur bakery: caramelised walnuts and short pastry in the most famous Swiss biscuit.

name: Chur - Grape Harvest Festival
description: Chur's September grape harvest festival in the Mittenberg vineyards: picking grapes pressing juice and celebrating with new wine.

name: Chur - Werkstatt Live Music
description: Chur's most respected live music venue with a strong programme of local and Swiss acts across rock jazz and electronic genres.

name: Chur - Arcas Bar Evening
description: Chur's Arcas square has a cluster of lively bars: a great starting point for an evening in Switzerland's oldest city.

name: Chur - Stadttheater Chur Performance
description: Chur's regional theatre with a strong programme of drama opera and musical productions serving the whole of Graubünden.

name: Chur - Rooftop Summer Bar
description: Seasonal rooftop bar above the Chur Old Town: cocktails and local wine with views over the medieval rooftops and the Rhine valley.

name: Chur - Lenzerheide DJ Après Evening
description: Bus up to Lenzerheide for après-ski DJ sets and live music at the resort's mountain bars: a livelier evening option near Chur.

name: Chur - Tamins Hot Springs Day Trip
description: Short drive to the thermal baths near Tamins above Chur: natural hot spring pools with views over the Rhine gorge and Graubünden Alps.

name: Chur - Plessur River Wild Swim
description: Wild swim in the Plessur river as it flows through Chur: cool clear mountain water and a beloved local summer tradition.

name: Chur - Lenzerheide Spa Valbella Inn
description: Full wellness spa at the Valbella Inn above Lenzerheide: indoor pool panoramic sauna and treatments with mountain lake views.

name: Chur - Arosa Kulm Spa Morning
description: Luxurious spa at the Arosa Kulm hotel with indoor outdoor pools sauna and Alpine botanical treatments at 1800m altitude.

name: Chur - Rheinpark Wellness Walk
description: Gentle restorative walk through Chur's Rhine embankment park: riverside meadows birds and the sound of the fast-flowing Rhine.

name: Chur - Rhine Gorge Via Ferrata
description: Fixed-rope climbing route in the Ruinaulta Rhine Gorge: an exposed and thrilling via ferrata through the Swiss Grand Canyon walls.

name: Chur - Arosa Mountain Bike Trails
description: Extensive mountain bike trail network above Arosa from easy forest singletracks to technical enduro descents back to the valley.

name: Chur - Lenzerheide Ski & Snowboard
description: Lenzerheide's 155km ski area connects with Arosa for 225km of skiing: excellent intermediate terrain with reliable snow conditions.

name: Chur - Chur E-Bike Vineyard Loop
description: Guided e-bike loop from Chur through the Mittenberg vineyards the Rhine embankment and the surrounding valley villages.

name: Basel - Art Basel Preview & Galleries
description: Explore Basel's extraordinary concentration of contemporary art galleries year-round: the city has more museums per capita than almost anywhere in Europe.

name: Basel - Kunstmuseum Basel
description: Switzerland's oldest and most important public art collection spanning Holbein the Younger to Cézanne Picasso and contemporary works.

name: Basel - Basel Münster Cathedral
description: Late Romanesque and Gothic cathedral on the Rhine terrace with a striking red sandstone facade and a cloister with Erasmus's tomb.

name: Basel - Old Town Walking Tour
description: Wander Basel's remarkably intact medieval core: the Marktplatz town hall painted facades guild halls and the narrow Spalenberg lanes.

name: Basel - Museum Tinguely
description: Dedicated museum for Jean Tinguely's kinetic sculptures and mechanical art: whirring clanking moving machines in a riverside building.

name: Basel - Fondation Beyeler
description: One of Switzerland's finest private museums in Riehen: Monet Rothko Warhol and African art in a Renzo Piano building with a lily pond.

name: Basel - Museum für Gegenwartskunst
description: Contemporary art museum on the Rhine presenting cutting-edge international and Swiss artists in a converted paper mill.

name: Basel - Basel Paper Mill Museum
description: Living museum in a medieval mill where visitors can make their own paper by hand: traces Basel's crucial role in early European printing.

name: Basel - Vitra Design Museum Day Trip
description: Cross into Germany to the Vitra Campus: world's greatest design museum with buildings by Zaha Hadid Gehry and Herzog & de Meuron.

name: Basel - Basel Historical Museum
description: Basel's city history museum in the Barfüsserkirche with medieval artefacts tapestries and the treasures of the Basel Cathedral.

name: Basel - Spalentor City Gate Walk
description: Visit Basel's best-preserved medieval city gate and walk the old city wall route: towers bastions and hidden gardens along the way.

name: Basel - Rhine Swimming
description: Drift downstream in the fast-flowing Rhine with locals using a Wickelfisch waterproof bag: Basel's most beloved summer ritual.

name: Basel - Rhine Promenade Walk
description: Walk both banks of the Rhine from the Mittlere Brücke past the Tinguely Fountain and on to the Dreiländereck where three countries meet.

name: Basel - Dreiländereck Three Countries Corner
description: Stand at the point where Switzerland Germany and France meet at the Rhine: a short tram ride from Basel centre with a monument and Rhine views.

name: Basel - Botanical Garden Basel
description: University of Basel botanical garden with tropical greenhouses an alpine garden and a fine collection of medicinal plants.

name: Basel - Lange Erlen Animal Park
description: Free city animal park in the Erlen forest with deer wild boar bison and a children's farm: a peaceful green escape from the city.

name: Basel - Black Forest Day Trip
description: Cross into Germany for a day hike in the Black Forest above Freiburg: dense fir trees waterfalls and the Feldberg summit.

name: Basel - Alsace Wine Route Cycle
description: Cycle across the French border into Alsace along the flat wine route through Ribeauvillé Riquewihr and the Vin d'Alsace villages.

name: Basel - Rhine Ferry Crossing
description: Cross the Rhine on one of Basel's four cable ferries powered only by the river current: a charming and very Swiss experience.

name: Basel - Marktplatz Farmers Market
description: Basel's famous daily market on the red town hall square: regional farmers selling cheese bread flowers vegetables and seasonal produce.

name: Basel - Basel Fasnacht Street Food
description: During Basel's three-day Carnival street stalls sell Mehlsuppe flour soup and Zwiebelwähe onion tart: unmissable winter street food.

name: Basel - Alsace Wine & Cheese Evening
description: Guided tasting of Alsatian Riesling Gewurztraminer and Pinot Gris paired with Münster cheese and regional charcuterie.

name: Basel - Basel Craft Beer Scene
description: Basel's craft beer scene has exploded: the Volta Bräu and other microbreweries produce excellent local ales lagers and seasonal specials.

name: Basel - Kleinbasel Restaurant Hop
description: Cross to the lesser-visited right bank for Basel's most authentic restaurant strip: Turkish Lebanese and Swiss kitchens side by side.

name: Basel - Confiserie Schiesser Café
description: Basel's most historic confiserie on the Marktplatz: Läckerli biscuits Kirsch cakes and coffee in a belle époque interior since 1870.

name: Basel - Basel Läckerli Baking Class
description: Learn to bake Basel's famous spiced honey biscuit in a local cooking class: the iconic Läckerli has been made here since the 15th century.

name: Basel - Gundeldingen Market
description: Multicultural neighbourhood market in the Gundeli district: the most diverse and local-feeling food market in Basel.

name: Basel - Campari Bar at the Kunsthalle
description: The bar of Basel's Kunsthalle is one of the city's great social institutions: art world crowd strong drinks and a buzzing atmosphere.

name: Basel - Basel Fasnacht Carnival
description: Switzerland's largest carnival beginning at 4am Monday with the Morgestraich: drums lanterns masks and three days of street chaos.

name: Basel - Kaserne Basel Live Music
description: Basel's premier independent music and theatre venue: a converted barracks with a strong programme of concerts club nights and performance art.

name: Basel - Steinenvorstadt Bar Strip
description: Basel's main nightlife street with cocktail bars student pubs clubs and late-night spots running the length of the pedestrian zone.

name: Basel - Bird's Eye Jazz Club
description: One of Switzerland's finest jazz clubs in a basement on the Kohlenberg: intimate nightly live acts and a warm underground atmosphere.

name: Basel - Open Air Kino Basel
description: Summer open-air cinema in the city with screenings at various parks and riverside locations: deckchairs snacks and films under the stars.

name: Basel - Aquabasilea Spa & Waterpark
description: Large thermal spa and waterpark near Basel with wave pools thermal baths sauna landscape and a full wellness treatment menu.

name: Basel - Rhine Hammam Kleinbasel
description: Traditional hammam in the Kleinbasel district offering full steam scrub and massage rituals in a beautifully tiled historic space.

name: Basel - Solitude Park Forest Walk
description: Peaceful walk through the wooded Solitude park above Basel with viewpoints over the city the Rhine valley and the Black Forest.

name: Basel - Basel Yoga & Wellness Studios
description: Basel has a thriving yoga scene with excellent drop-in studios in the city centre offering Vinyasa Yin and Ashtanga classes.

name: Basel - Indoor Climbing Kletterhalle Basel
description: Basel's main bouldering and lead climbing gym with routes for all levels equipment hire and a training board for serious climbers.

name: Basel - Rhine Stand-Up Paddleboard
description: Paddleboard on the Rhine above the fast section: guided tours along the calmer upstream stretches with city and bridge views.

name: Basel - Road Cycling Alsace Loop
description: Road cycling loop from Basel across the French border through the Alsatian vineyards and back: flat terrain and exceptional scenery.

name: Basel - Jura Hiking Day Trip
description: Day hike in the Swiss Jura north of Basel: limestone ridges waterfalls wild horses and long views over three countries.

name: Basel - E-Bike City & Rhine Tour
description: Guided e-bike tour covering Basel's highlights both banks of the Rhine and a cross-border loop into France or Germany.
